pr_title: fix: handle directory permissions in SaveUploadedFile
pr_body: This pull request addresses the issue where SaveUploadedFile attempts to change the permissions of existing directories, such as /tmp, which leads to an error. The problem occurred because the function calls os.Chmod on the target directory even if it already exists. To fix this, the code now checks if the directory exists before attempting to change its permissions. This is achieved by using os.Stat to check if the directory exists. If it does, the function skips the call to os.Chmod. The change ensures that SaveUploadedFile no longer attempts to modify the permissions of existing system directories. This pull request is related to issue #4622, which describes the problem in detail. The fix has been tested by checking that SaveUploadedFile no longer fails when saving files to existing system directories.

files_changed.why: Modified the SaveUploadedFile function to check if the target directory exists before attempting to change its permissions.
